description: Get the secret value of one stage: previous (value used before the current one), active (value in use) or pending (new value awaiting rotation completion). ⚠️ The response contains the secret value in plain text.

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

stage.description: Secret value stage: previous | active | pending

name: ncloud_secret_get_secret_stage_value
